confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are supported by recent Xiamen price aggregates and approximate the requested July 2026 window. Cocktail and wine-glass prices are less certain: they are estimated from local beer and reported mid-range bottle-wine prices. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city used for food and drink; those estimates use Xiamen-specific aggregates. Accommodation is estimated for a coastal Fujian city with Xiamen's tourism demand.
